title: Users cannot stake in `UniV3Staking`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  `UniswapV3Staking.stake()` pulls NFTs from the user in the following way:  ```solidity         positionManager.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), tokenId); ```  However, this will end up calling the `onERC721Received()` function on the `UniswapV3Staking` contract, and expect a return value. However since that function is not implemented in this contract, the ERC721 transfer will fail, reverting the execution of `stake()`.  ## Recommendations  Implement the following function to ensure that ERC721's can be received
